codes.title: SD card read error
codes.action: Check the SD card contacts; format or replace the card and select the model again.

codes.title: Invalid model file
codes.action: Prepare the model again. Check its header, records, checksums and supported commands.

codes.title: Print file read interrupted
codes.action: Check the SD card or host storage. A failed print is not resumed automatically.

codes.title: Extruder heating error
codes.action: Check the hotend heater, sensor and wiring. Fix the cause before FIRMWARE_RESTART.
codes.detection: Native verify_heater; a prolonged temperature drop may also use this native message

codes.title: Extruder temperature too high
codes.action: Allow cooling and inspect the heater, sensor and wiring before restarting.
codes.detection: Explicit hotend overtemperature or MCU high hotend ADC, excluding rails

codes.title: Heatbed temperature too high
codes.action: Allow cooling and inspect the bed heater and sensor before restarting.
codes.detection: Explicit bed overtemperature or MCU low bed ADC, excluding rails

codes.title: Unexpected extruder temperature drop
codes.action: Check the heater, sensor and wiring. Only an explicitly identified drop uses this code.

codes.title: Heatbed thermistor error
codes.action: Check the bed sensor and its wiring. Missing data is not proof of overheating.
codes.detection: Identified bed sensor range / stale ADC

codes.title: Extruder thermistor connection error
codes.action: Check the hotend sensor and its connection. Missing data is not proof of overheating.
codes.detection: Identified hotend sensor range / stale ADC

codes.title: Small platform connector error
codes.action: Check the small platform connector. PE15 alone cannot distinguish the two connectors.

codes.title: Large platform connector error
codes.action: Check the large platform connector. PE15 alone cannot distinguish the two connectors.

codes.title: Main extruder cable error
codes.action: Check the main extruder cable and connectors. There is no separate qualified cable detector in this port.
codes.detection: Explicit cable diagnosis / operator report only

codes.title: Perforated plate contacts error
codes.action: Inspect the plate contacts and connector; clean the nozzle and metal pads.
codes.detection: Explicit plate-contact diagnosis; general probe failures use 042

codes.title: XY endstop error
codes.action: Check the XY endstops and wiring; remove obstructions before homing again.

codes.title: Extruder gear / ribbon inspection
codes.action: Inspect the extruder gear, filament path and ribbon. This message does not imply automatic jam sensing.
codes.detection: Explicit confirmed report only; no automatic gear feedback

codes.title: Firmware update required for file
codes.action: The file requires a newer firmware format than the audited profile supports.

codes.title: Calibration failed
codes.action: Check platform adjustment and measurement results, then repeat Autocalibration.

codes.title: Pad probing failed
codes.action: Check clean nozzle contact, pad bounds and platform connection before repeating the procedure.
codes.detection: Contact or actual probing failure, not a missing homing / heating precondition

codes.title: Newer Z-Suite version required
codes.action: Prepare the file using a supported Z-Suite version. Arbitrary format errors do not establish its age.
codes.detection: Explicit version diagnosis only; no invented minimum software version

codes.title: File exported for another printer
codes.action: Export the model for the classic M300; Inventure, Plus and Dual are different families.

codes.title: No models on SD card
codes.action: Copy supported models to the SD card and refresh the folder.

native.title: Native Klipper shutdown
native.action: Read the original Klipper reason. Fix the cause before an explicit firmware restart.

native.title: Timer too close
native.action: Inspect host scheduling and communication diagnostics. The native timing guard remains active.

native.title: Stepper timing error
native.action: Inspect the stepper timing failure in klippy.log. The native motion shutdown remains active.

native.title: Klipper connection lost
native.action: Check the host and UART link. Reconnection never clears the motion or heating latch.

native.title: Emergency stop
native.action: Check why the emergency stop was requested before restarting.

native.title: Platform connector fault
native.action: Check both platform connectors. PE15 does not identify which connector caused the fault.

native.title: Temperature sensor / ADC fault
native.action: Inspect the original sensor/ADC reason; the channel has not been identified reliably.

native.title: MCU safety guard latched
native.action: Inspect the local guard reason. Fault acknowledgement never clears the safety latch.
